The media rights rollforward calculation failed due to a significant numerical discrepancy in the Film Rights sheet.
The test_legacy_node_checks in test_output.py failed with an AssertionError during the execution of test_outputs.js. While the output workbook and sheet structure were correct, a specific cell check failed: 'Film Rights #2710!O6 expected 6 got 30402.47'. Avoid logic that incorrectly aggregates or offsets financial values, as the current implementation produced a value several orders of magnitude higher than expected.
